visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a black headband and a black T-shirt, sits in an indoor setting. Behind her is a grey sofa with colorful yellow and pink pillows. She holds a large purple box with 'Disney VILLAINS' printed on it, smiling brightly and gesturing with her hands, which feature silver glitter nail polish. (2) The camera moves closer as she picks up a smaller blind box from the main package. She begins to tear off the outer plastic film and open the cardboard lid. The lighting is bright and studio-like, illuminating the glossy texture of the packaging and her facial features clearly. (3) She pulls a silver foil bag out of the box and shakes it toward the camera before tearing it open. She reveals a small Maleficent figurine with large purple eyes, black horns, and a purple robe. She holds it close to the lens to show the intricate details and translucent eye effects. (4) In a new phase, she reveals the next toy, Ursula. The figure has striking white hair, blue eyes, and a purple skin tone, holding a green eel accessory. The background remains consistent as she rotates the figure to show all sides. (5) She unboxes the third character, Cruella de Vil, characterized by her iconic half-black and half-white hair and a white fur coat with black spots. She points out the texture of the coat and the character's signature green earrings while looking directly at the camera. (6) The unboxing continues as she reveals Hades, featuring blue translucent hair and holding red and green flame accessories. She compares the physical toy to the artwork on the box, showing her excitement through wide smiles and rapid hand movements. (7) She reveals the Queen of Hearts toy, which wears a red, black, and gold dress and a golden crown. She highlights the character's facial expression and the pose of the figurine. (8) The final unboxing reveal is the Evil Queen, who wears a purple gown and a large gold crown, holding a miniature red heart box. The woman claps her hands together in a celebratory gesture and nods to the camera. (9) The woman claps her hands together and smiles widely towards the lens. (10) The visual transitions to a shot of a white display case. She carefully places the new Maleficent figurine onto a clear acrylic stand among a large collection of other Disney-themed toys and accessories. The camera pans across the diverse collection, showing various villains and princess figurines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female speech begins immediately with a bright, fast-tempo electronic BGM bed featuring clear drum machine hits. The vocal pitch is sharp and expressive, conveying enthusiasm. (2) At 0:21, a distinct plastic rustling sound occurs as a package is opened, followed by a vocalized 'Deng deng deng' that mimics a celebratory trumpet. (3) A bright metallic 'Ding' SFX sounds at 0:24 as the first toy is revealed. The BGM continues steadily in a major mode. (4) Periodic plastic crinkling and soft thuds from the box handling are heard throughout. Vocal tone remains upbeat and fast-paced. (5) New metallic chime SFX triggers at 0:49 and 1:00 for subsequent reveals, synchronized with the woman's excited exclamations of the characters' names. (6) A sharp 'Ding' SFX highlights the reveal of the hidden version, accompanied by a noticeable rise in vocal pitch and intensity. (7) Rhythmic hand clapping sounds occur at 1:49, clearly audible above the music. The BGM begins a repetitive loop pattern for the outro. (8) The final phase features a shift to a slightly softer, more narrational vocal tone as she describes the display case. The BGM continues at a consistent volume until the final cut.
